```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .byo-outer {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 1em 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .byo-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: #5654A2;
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }

  .byo-header-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(248, 247, 240, 0.2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .byo-header-icon svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .byo-header-text {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .byo-section-bar {
    padding: 7px 16px;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #9B8EA0;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .byo-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    background: #F8F7F0;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  }

  .byo-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 18px 16px;
    text-align: center;
    border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .byo-card:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .byo-card:hover { background: #F0EFF8; }
  .byo-card:hover .byo-card-icon { background: #F8F7F0; }

  .byo-card-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .byo-card-icon svg {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    color: #5654A2;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .byo-label {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #5654A2;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .byo-sub {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75em;
    color: #9B8EA0;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .byo-desc {
    font-size: 0.88em;
    color: #564232;
    line-height: 1.5;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .byo-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .byo-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: left;
      border-right: none;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
      padding: 14px;
      gap: 0 12px;
    }
    .byo-card:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .byo-card-icon { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / -1; margin-bottom: 0; align-self: center; }
    .byo-label { grid-column: 2; margin-bottom: 1px; }
    .byo-sub { grid-column: 2; margin-bottom: 1px; }
    .byo-desc { grid-column: 2; margin-top: 0; }
  }
</style>

<div class="byo-outer">
  <div class="byo-header">
    <div class="byo-header-icon"><i data-lucide="blocks"></i></div>
    <span class="byo-header-text">Build on Your Own</span>
  </div>

  <div class="byo-section-bar">Extensible via</div>
  <div class="byo-grid">
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon"><i data-lucide="puzzle"></i></div>
      <div class="byo-label">Plugins</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Summoned via <code>/</code> commands</div>
    </div>
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon"><i data-lucide="file-text"></i></div>
      <div class="byo-label">Rules</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Live under <code>.claude/</code></div>
    </div>
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon"><i data-lucide="zap"></i></div>
      <div class="byo-label">API Calls</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Saved as env variables</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="byo-section-bar">LLM Stack</div>
  <div class="byo-grid">
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon">
        <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#CC785C" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M17.3041 3.541h-3.6718l6.696 16.918H24Zm-10.6082 0L0 20.459h3.7442l1.3693-3.5527h7.0052l1.3693 3.5528h3.7442L10.5363 3.5409Zm-.3712 10.2232 2.2914-5.9456 2.2914 5.9456Z"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="byo-label">Claude Code</div>
      <div class="byo-sub">Anthropic</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Master LLM</div>
    </div>
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon">
        <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#10A37F" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M22.2819 9.8211a5.9847 5.9847 0 0 0-.5157-4.9108 6.0462 6.0462 0 0 0-6.5098-2.9A6.0651 6.0651 0 0 0 4.9807 4.1818a5.9847 5.9847 0 0 0-3.9977 2.9 6.0462 6.0462 0 0 0 .7427 7.0966 5.98 5.98 0 0 0 .511 4.9107 6.051 6.051 0 0 0 6.5146 2.9001A5.9847 5.9847 0 0 0 13.2599 24a6.0557 6.0557 0 0 0 5.7718-4.2058 5.9894 5.9894 0 0 0 3.9977-2.9001 6.0557 6.0557 0 0 0-.7475-7.0729zm-9.022 12.6081a4.4755 4.4755 0 0 1-2.8764-1.0408l.1419-.0804 4.7783-2.7582a.7948.7948 0 0 0 .3927-.6813v-6.7369l2.02 1.1686a.071.071 0 0 1 .038.052v5.5826a4.504 4.504 0 0 1-4.4945 4.4944zm-9.6607-4.1254a4.4708 4.4708 0 0 1-.5346-3.0137l.142.0852 4.783 2.7582a.7712.7712 0 0 0 .7806 0l5.8428-3.3685v2.3324a.0804.0804 0 0 1-.0332.0615L9.74 19.9502a4.4992 4.4992 0 0 1-6.1408-1.6464zM2.3408 7.8956a4.485 4.485 0 0 1 2.3655-1.9728V11.6a.7664.7664 0 0 0 .3879.6765l5.8144 3.3543-2.0201 1.1685a.0757.0757 0 0 1-.071 0l-4.8303-2.7865A4.504 4.504 0 0 1 2.3408 7.872zm16.5963 3.8558L13.1038 8.364 15.1192 7.2a.0757.0757 0 0 1 .071 0l4.8303 2.7913a4.4944 4.4944 0 0 1-.6765 8.1042v-5.6772a.79.79 0 0 0-.407-.667zm2.0107-3.0231l-.142-.0852-4.7735-2.7818a.7759.7759 0 0 0-.7854 0L9.409 9.2297V6.8974a.0662.0662 0 0 1 .0284-.0615l4.8303-2.7866a4.4992 4.4992 0 0 1 6.6802 4.66zM8.3065 12.863l-2.02-1.1638a.0804.0804 0 0 1-.038-.0567V6.0742a4.4992 4.4992 0 0 1 7.3757-3.4537l-.142.0805L8.704 5.459a.7948.7948 0 0 0-.3927.6813zm1.0976-2.3654l2.602-1.4998 2.6069 1.4998v2.9994l-2.5974 1.4997-2.6067-1.4997Z"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="byo-label">Codex</div>
      <div class="byo-sub">OpenAI</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Reviewer</div>
    </div>
    <div class="byo-card">
      <div class="byo-card-icon">
        <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#4285F4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M11.04 19.32Q12 21.51 12 24q0-2.49.93-4.68.96-2.19 2.58-3.81t3.81-2.55Q21.51 12 24 12q-2.49 0-4.68-.93a12.3 12.3 0 0 1-3.81-2.58 12.3 12.3 0 0 1-2.58-3.81Q12 2.49 12 0q0 2.49-.96 4.68-.93 2.19-2.55 3.81a12.3 12.3 0 0 1-3.81 2.58Q2.49 12 0 12q2.49 0 4.68.96 2.19.93 3.81 2.55t2.55 3.81"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="byo-label">Gemini CLI</div>
      <div class="byo-sub">Google</div>
      <div class="byo-desc">Image generation</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();
</script>
```
